violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Refrigerator in the breakfast area was found at 48F. Refrigerator in the laundry area was found at 55F. Refrigerated units must be capable of maintaining potentially hazardous foods at 41F or below.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Thermometer was not available in the refrigerator in the dry storage area. All refrigerated units should be provided with thermometers.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Milk in breakfast fridge was found at 51F. Milk was in this fridge for 1 hour. It was previously held in the refrigerator in the laundry area that was found at 55F. Potentially hazardous foods should be held at 41F or below. **Milk was pulled from the breakfast fridge, to be used for personal use.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)
Thermometers provided, used, clean, and accurate (1 pt deducted)
